dialogues.speaker: Umm
dialogues.text: Greetings, welcome to Gandharva Ville.

dialogues.speaker: Umm
dialogues.text: Life is comfortable here, right? It's much better than the city!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Tell me about yourself...

dialogues.speaker: Umm
dialogues.text: I'm the longest living resident here... One of them anyway. Perhaps only Keon, who's a few years my elder, can compete with me.

dialogues.speaker: Umm
dialogues.text: It was a blessing in disguise, this carefree life in the forest.

dialogues.speaker: Umm
dialogues.text: I was a researcher of the Akademiya in my youth, but I was caught up in vicious academic competition.

dialogues.speaker: Umm
dialogues.text: Hmph! I didn't want to fight with those unethical researchers. A secluded life in the forest was way better.

dialogues.speaker: Umm
dialogues.text: It was at here where I realized that knowledge, power, and wealth are the source of our troubles, and that a simple life is the best life.

dialogues.speaker: Umm
dialogues.text: Those youngsters from the Akademiya should learn the Forest Rangers' way of life!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Do you not like the city?

dialogues.speaker: Umm
dialogues.text: What's so great about the city? Its atmosphere always feels weird to me.

dialogues.speaker: Umm
dialogues.text: No matter how tall the buildings that are built leaning against the Divine Tree are, we seem to draw no closer to the gods.

dialogues.speaker: Umm
dialogues.text: Otherwise, why would researchers who so desperately yearn for knowledge come to Avidya Forest to gain success?

dialogues.speaker: Umm
dialogues.text: ...Not that I'm saying that knowledge is that good, but you should understand what I mean, right?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: See you.

dialogues.speaker: Umm
dialogues.text: You're leaving already? *sigh* You still haven't understood the true meaning of a carefree life, I see.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Forest Rangers are civil servants too...

dialogues.speaker: Umm
dialogues.text: ...You can't just group them up together because they are all civil servants!

dialogues.speaker: Umm
dialogues.text: Let me explain... It's like how... the Dendro Archon and the Greater Lord are incomparable to each other. Do you get it now?

dialogues.speaker: Umm
dialogues.text: Instead of asking me more questions, why don't you just stay a few days? I'm certain you'll get to know the simplicity and beauty of forest life.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Forest Rangers are civil servants too...

dialogues.speaker: Umm
dialogues.text: ...You can't just lump them all together because they are all civil servants!

dialogues.speaker: Umm
dialogues.text: Let me give you an example... It's like... It's like how Bouncy Mushrooms and Floppy Mushrooms are all mushrooms, but their characteristics are completely different. Get it?

dialogues.speaker: Umm
dialogues.text: You know what? Instead of asking me more questions, why don't you just stay a few days? I'm certain you'll understand the simplicity and beauty of forest life then.
